question: Mohan gets 12% increase in his sale amount in the first year and 15% increase in the second year, with that his present sale is ₹1,28,800. What was his sale two years ago?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Net multiplier for 12% and 15% increase = 1.12 × 1.15 = 1.288

Sale two years ago = Present Sale ÷ Net Multiplier

Sale = 1,28,800 ÷ 1.288 = 1,00,000

**∴ The correct answer is ₹1,00,000.**
